_doc: Frozen C2.4 expectation, hand-derived from task/dispositions.json against v1. 'modified' lists the v1 elements (as ISO locators, resolved on v1) whose own text the v2 edits change; EVERY other tracked v1 element must map to a v2 element with status 'unchanged'. 'inserted' lists anchors of elements that exist only in v2. 'renumbered' is the exact expected set of old->new pairs (by anchor).
